item.title: Helias reaches goal of getting back to softball Final Four | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Helias Lady Crusaders have had a chip on their shoulders. After advancing to the softball Final Four for three straight seasons, that run came to an end with a loss to Rock Bridge in the Class 5 District 4 title game in the fall of 2025. Helias’ five seniors have long memories. “They had a taste of getting to the Final Four as freshmen and sophomores and losing to Rock Bridge stung a little bit,” Helias coach Kelly Fick said. That sting has gone away as the Lady Crusaders prepared for the Class 4 Final Four starting today at the Killian Softball Complex in Springfield. Second-ranked Helias will take on sixth-ranked Platte County in a game scheduled to start at noon.
